source: CLIENT_MUST_SUPPLY (brand intake sheet or owner-provided brand guide)
_palette_note: Fill palette with the client's own #RRGGBB colors: scripts/brand_colors.py record writes it from the client's answer. Slots gold/navy/cream are accent-CTA, dark, light; extra hex keys are allowed. brand_id must name this client (it is checked against intake brand_owner).

font_policy.note: CLIENT context: agent derives best display/body/accent for this client's job, documents rationale in bible, reviewer approves. Never blocked on fonts.

layout_thresholds.note: Item 15 layout metric defaults, read by scripts/validate_page.py; declare mandated editorial structures in card_grid_allowlist so the repeated-card-grid metric passes them by declaration: each entry is a sibling group's parent selector, its structure signature, or the pair joined by a space. Worked examples: "section.persona-rows", "div(p,h3,p)", "section.letter-body div(p)".
